# The Junkluggers

> The Junkluggers provides professional, eco-friendly junk removal and hauling services with same-day pickup, recycling, and donation options across residential and commercial properties.

The Junkluggers specializes in comprehensive junk removal services including appliances, furniture, e-waste, and specialty items like pianos and hot tubs. The company emphasizes environmental responsibility through recycling, donation programs, and EPA-compliant disposal practices.

- free estimates
